description: Repository-owned proof-of-concept candidates of the CPU-only audit service. A candidate is the ATTACKER's code that the immutable trusted harness evaluates inside the EVM; it never states a verdict. The expected outcome below is the maintainer's expectation and is used by the end-to-end test as a cross-check - the trusted harness, not this file, decides the actual verdict.

entries.note: Vulnerable target: withdrawAll() transfers value before it zeroes the depositor balance. The trusted harness must report a solvency breach.

Negative control: the same candidate against the ReentrancyGuard-protected control. The trusted harness must NOT report a breach - this is the evidence that the service does not confirm vulnerabilities falsely.
